name: zdeclient_crater_init_feature_from_event_template
description: zDEClient_Crater::InitFeatureFromEventTemplate creates a crater feature, binds it to the camera feature grid cell, clamps it inside the cell, populates circle points and bounds, and rejects full cells.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient crater/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x456c80 validates the CreateFeatureStructFromEventTemplate call, camera-world lookup, WorldToGridCoordsClamped and GetFeatureGridCell calls, full-cell rejection, center adjustment against cell bounds, sin/cos circle point generation, min/max X/Z bounds accumulation, and overlap rejection scan against ZDEC_FEATURE node contexts.

The native zDEClient feature init smoke verifies successful crater feature initialization through the production helper path, including display-source selection, grid-cell assignment, generated four-point circle geometry, bounds, and full-cell rejection.
